newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, BAT IN FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WIN TOSS, BAT IN FIRST TEST.

text.p: India won the toss and decided to bat in the first of two tests against Sri Lanka at Colombo's R.Premadasa stadium on Saturday.

SRI LANKA: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Marvan Atapattu, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Mahela Jayawardena, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Muthiah Muralitharan, Jayantha Silva
INDIA: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Navjot Sidhu, Nayan Mongia, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Saurav Ganguly, Anil Kumble, Rajesh Chauhan, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvila, Nilesh Kulkarni.
UMPIRES: Kandiah Francis (Sri Lanka) and Steve Randall (Australia).
